meet-us.title: Meet Us
meet-us.body:
At Tim's Gourmet Sliders, we're not just flipping patties—we're crafting an experience. Tim's vision is to deliver sliders that pack a big punch, made with the finest ingredients and a dash of flair, all served with the kind of care you'd expect from a seasoned pro.

Our team is dedicated, responsible, and downright excited to bring you sliders that elevate the everyday into something extraordinary. We're here to make your day delicious—one gourmet bite at a time!

teamMembers.name: Tim
teamMembers.bio:
Tim has been a lifelong foodie with a deep-rooted passion for exceptional flavors and top-notch service. With years of experience in both fine dining and casual dining, he's honed his craft as a culinary pro, working in kitchens where quality and creativity reign supreme.

After traveling far and wide, tasting burgers from coast to coast, Tim noticed a gap in the food scene—there simply wasn't a slider that lived up to his gourmet standards. So, he decided to change the game.

"We chose to focus on sliders because we want to put a high-end meal in the palm of your hand. Everyone loves burgers, so we decided to put our gourmet touch and creativity on the classic slider."

teamMembers.name: Christey
teamMembers.bio:
As our dedicated Event Coordinator, Christey ensures every catering experience with Tim's Gourmet Sliders exceeds expectations. With her meticulous attention to detail and passion for creating memorable food experiences, she works closely with clients to customize menus and coordinate flawless service.

Christey brings warmth and professionalism to every interaction, making the planning process as enjoyable as the sliders themselves. Her expertise in event management means your gathering will run smoothly from setup to cleanup.

Whether you're planning a corporate function, wedding reception, or backyard celebration, Christey will help bring your vision to life with Tim's Gourmet Sliders as the highlight of your event.

reviews.author: RD D
reviews.body: Tim and his crew came out to our dealerships and feed everyone. These Burgers are Excellent. The Steak slider and the impossible Burger are really Tasty and the Fries good too. Tim come back next year please.

reviews.author: James Hargrove
reviews.body: Best sliders i ever had. Highly recommend, one of the best food trucks in the metro area along with genuine customer service and ownership 10/10

reviews.author: Sandra Anger
reviews.body: EXCELLENT food and service! Made our graduation party extra special. The sliders and fries got RAVE reviews from everyone. Very friendly, organized, and professional. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Anita Rodgers
reviews.body: Tim's Food truck is the best food truck ever! If you want delicious food with a variety of choices this is your company. The customer service is exceptional and to me beyond 5 stars. My annual picnic for my group of stroke survivors will definitely be memorable and Tim's Food Truck helped to make this happen. Thank you again.

reviews.author: Marlo Rencher
reviews.body: Tim's Gourmet Sliders truly elevated my event! The food was amazing and the friendly staff was extremely professional throughout the process. The game changer is the pager system for guests so that they can enjoy the event after they order and pick up hot, delicious sliders once they're ready. Absolutely recommend!

reviews.author: Jim McBroom
reviews.body: Tim's Gourmet Sliders were in our neighborhood tonight serving up the goods! We got the Steak Burger Sliders & the Garlic Chicken Sliders served up with delicious french fries! I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Rebecca Padin
reviews.body: Tim's Gourmet Sliders boasts a fantastic variety of sliders with fries, serving up something for everyone! Quick turnaround makes it easy to please a crowd, and prices are very reasonable. Punctual, friendly, and great for a block party!

reviews.author: Lisa Golden
reviews.body: Tim's Sliders were amazing! The best black and blue burger I've ever had...I could have eaten 10 more! Can't want to have them again at a company event. I HIGHLY recommend 100%. Fresh and super high quality ingredients. I need to reverse engineer the sauce that was on my burger. I'll be dreaming about it for months!

reviews.author: Shawn Disbrow
reviews.body: Wow! Just Wow!! Decided to have a company tailgate lunch, best choice we made was choosing Tim's! The food was absolutely fantastic as well as the service! Rave reviews from all of the employees! Best sliders I've had, ever! Will definitely be calling upon you again! Thank you!

reviews.author: Lin Beckhold
reviews.body: They were at our local library today and the food was great! I got the steakhouse sliders, hubby got the bacon cheeseburger, and they were bigger and better then we expected. Their fries were great as well. We will be watching for them in our travels.

reviews.author: Christie R
reviews.body: Had a great experience using them for our daughters grad party. Guests were impressed with the food and how quick it came out. Guests even got beepers for when their food was ready. We had 150+ people and all I heard was how great it was

reviews.author: Kimberly Schermesser
reviews.body: Great communication, easy to work with and excellent food! Everyone at our event was impressed with how great everything was. I will use Tim's again for all my events. Well done!
